ev_0005.summary: Circle_01 is centred at O (263.7,258.9) with r about 196.7. Diameter AB lies on the horizontal line, with A and B on the circle. Chord CA (seg_03) joins C and A, both on the circle. Vertical segment DG (seg_02) passes through F on AB, with D and G on the circle. Segment OE (seg_04) runs from the centre O to E, which lies inside the circle on DG.
